Ph.226619 --- Page 5 --- AGANCHENGANI A'chikrangni bidingo rokom rokom A'chikkuchi seanirang ka'sne ka'sne bang'rorobaengha.
Indioba chugipa gadangrango poraigiparangna aro skia man'gipa manderangna Seanirang komibeenga.
Ia ka'dongsona man'a.
Jatprakni gimin rokom rokom seani dongna nanggen.
Uamangni daka-rikani, cha'bewal-robewalni aro agangipa ku'sikrangni gimin seani gipin manderang ma'sina neng'gen, aro iandakgipa rokom rokom mangmang chanchie sesretanirang dongangaha.
Uni gimin jattangni chong'motgipa noksako on'na skia man'giparangni kam ong'a.
Ia kitapko anga "A'chikkuni Ma'ambi" ine done, A'chikkuni a'bachengbaani, uni ja'pang-ja'dil aro gipinrangni Kattarangko dingtang dingtang chasongrango jakkalchapbaani giminsan mangmang seaha.

A'chikkuni gam'ani bewalrang (Phonetics), Sentencerangni dingtang ong'ani (morphology), A'chikku Grammar aro Sentencerangko rikani bewalrang (Syntax) ko iano on'tisaba janapa dongja maina uarangko sena gita uandakgipa subjectko poraigipa mande ong'na nanggen indiba indakgiparangko seanirang dongjaskal A'chik ku'sikko rongtale u'ina man'jawa.
Ia kitapko North-Eastcm Hlill University Garo Major Subject dake ra'na donataha.
Ian chu'sokbegipa Seani ong'jaoba iako porae A'chikkuni bidingo aro A'chikni itihasni gimin adita u'ianiko on'gen ine anga ka'donga.
Milton S.
Sangma, Professorand Head, Dated Shillong, Departmentof History, the Ist March,1 North-Eastern Hill University Shillong.

Na2088 Aut tg --- Page 7 --- KATTA BICHONGRANG Aganchengani Jak Bak-1 : Ku'sikni Ong'baani gimin u'ie ra'chengani aro Chanchichipanirang 1-8 Bak-II : A'chikkuni Ja'pang-Ja'dil aro Bakdrang 9-18 Bak III : A'chik Ku'sik : Abachengbaani aro Dal'roroani 19-35 Bak IV: Britishna Skanggipa Chasong 36-44 :Britishni Chasong Bak V 45-52 Bak VI : Da'ororoni Re'mikkangangani 53-56 --- Page 9 --- WIL-IAMNAGAR BAK-I KU'SIKNI ONG'BAANI GIMIN U'IE RA'CHENGANI ARO CHANCHICHIPANIRANG U'IE RA'CHENGANI: A'chik ku'sikni ong'bachengani aro uni ritchani ritcha chasongrangni gisepo dalrorobaani gimin sena skang, pilak jatni ku sikrangni ong'bachengani ba Ku'sikko Aganna a'bachengbaani gimin banga chanchichipanirang gnanggenchimoba uarangoni minggni ba minggittam chanchichipanirangkosan rokom kitaprangko poraigipa manderangna ia kattani gimin talatna man'a aro ku sikni ong bachenganio, dalrorobanio aro apalrorobanio mai obostarang uarangko taribaaha, jakkin dilbaaha aro indaken ia gadangona sokatbaaha ua pilakko darangba u'itokna man jani gimin ka'mao kan'dik kan'dik dake adita talatchengenga.
Skanggipa an'chingni u'ie ra'chengna nanganiara - Ku'sikara agangipa katasa, lekkao segipa ong'ja.
Beben mandeni chanchianiko aro agananiko lekkao see rakkiani, unikoa uko chapa ka'ani bewalara nambatrorogipa kam ong'a, jean dongjaode, an'ching an'chingni chol dongjawachim.

An'ching chengo ning'tue aro apale chanchigimin ong'aigenchim aro dao an'ching maidake uarangko poraina man'a indake poraina aro ma'sina chol ong'srangjawachim, maina an'chingo u'ina maming chol dongjawachim, aro an'chingni agangipa ku'sikrangko gipin gipin a'songrango agangipa ku'sikrang baksa tosusae nina gita gipin chol dongsrangjawachim.

Uandake Englishrang Alfred The Great --- Page 10 --- ba Julius Caesami chasongo maidakgipa English ku'sikko agana, kattarang maidakgiparang ong'a aro uni Grammarara mai dakachim, uarangni see donanggiminrangonikosa porae u'ina man'aha.
Uandake segiminrangko sandie niesa u'iskana man'gen.

Beben daororo research ba sandie - rekkie niani cholrang namen bangbataha, jedake, Tape kae ra'ani, Film dake ra'ani, Computer aro re'a doani cholrang aro uandake indiba apsan daken rake research ba sandi-rekkie ninade nanggen.

Uni gimin dao Ku'sikni bidingo ma'sina gita see rakkigimin lekkarango pangchakbatrorona nangahani gimin Seani aro poraiani Ku'sikni bidingo tale ma'sina gita Segimin ba Chapa Ka'gimin kattarango pangchakanian an'chingni dakbewal ong'baaha.
Indiba Chapa ka'ani aro Jakchi seaniara agangipa Ku'sikni palsa ong'aia.
Chong'motko sandiode indake nikgen je Ku 'sikara Aganwatwataigipa (Oral) ong 'aia.
Beben mande ku'sikni dalroroaniko Sea-jotachi ba Chapa ka'anichi namen bariata indiba maidake aganachim ukosan seaia ine bon'kamode an'ching nikgen.

Ku'sikni bidingo ning'tubee aro apalbee chanchigiparang aro segiparangni ma'siani gita, a'bachengo aganani bewalara be'en-bimang, jak-ja'a ba mikgronrangchi chin dakesa jekon itihas sechenggipa chasongrangoni jakkalachim uara Agananichi ba Seanichi agangrikako miksonga, aro ia minggnini gisepo Ku'sikchi Gnigipao, Ku'sik uan uan dongaigipa ong'ja.

ua dao aro pangnan segipa English Ku'sik baksa tosusaode, is bilsi ritcha bonga ba una bata bilsirangni gisepo English Ku'sik namen dingtangbeaha ine altuen ma'sina man'a aro ua chasongna bate Anglo-Saxonni somoerangona niatgenchim ong'ode, dingtanggrikani bangbata ine an'ching altuen nikgen.
Chong'motko agangenchim ong'ode indake aganna man'gen je, Chaucerni English daororoni English baksa dingtanggrikanina bate
